lines.text: MangoLeaf AI helps mango farmers check mango leaves and Mango Green Fruit with on-device AI, even offline.
It recognizes five disease classes: Anthracnose, Bacterial Canker, Sooty Mold, Bacterial Black Spot, and Mango Scab, plus Healthy Leaf and Healthy Fruit.
It is built with Next.js, React, Bun, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, TensorFlow.js, Dexie, IndexedDB, Supabase, and Serwist. The model is MobileNetV3-Large.
This demo follows one simple path: scan, take a photo, review the diagnosed result, open Scan History, then view the scan detail modal.
MangoLeaf AI checks mango health right on your phone, even offline.
Read the Photo Tips, then choose Take Photo for this simple demo. Capture one clear mango leaf or Mango Green Fruit.
Center one whole mango in the Green Box Guidance, then capture your photo.
Review your photo. After that, tap Run AI Diagnosis to start the on-device check.
Please wait a moment while the on-device model checks your photo. After that, review the result.
Review the predicted condition, Confidence Score, and treatment guidance in English.
Switch to Bisaya to share these treatment steps.
Your saved scans stay in Scan History for a quick return.
Open a saved scan to review the photo, result, and treatment guidance.
Switch the guidance to Bisaya when it helps.
Clear Bisaya guidance helps Mango Farmers choose next steps.
